intuition: In a BST, the first node whose value lies between the two targets is where their paths split.

brute_force.approach: Build both root-to-target paths and return their last shared node.

optimal.approach: Walk left when both targets are smaller, right when both are larger, otherwise return the current split node.

edge_cases: One target may be the ancestor of the other.
The targets may lie on opposite sides of the root.
